output.summary: This market asks if the Republican Party will control both the House of Representatives and the Senate starting in February 2027. A YES share in this market will pay $1 if both Republican control events happen and $0 if not. The current price is about 10 cents, meaning the market estimates a 10% chance that Republicans will control both chambers. This helps people guess how likely this combined political outcome is.
